_about: Bugs found on posts, each attached to its post (layout v4, week_board.py --bugs): the files Krish put in Bugs & Issues on 7 Nov and his scored words on Wed 4 Nov, with the cause from the post-mortem (docs/learning/2026-11-07-week-of-2-nov-postmortem.md, section 2). None is guarded yet: the post-mortem lists them as causes, not guards. Change state to guarded or fixed, with the guard that catches it, when one lands.

bugs.title: The caption repeats the title and breaks mid-phrase
bugs.cause: The frame shows the title "DOES THAT MATTER?" while the caption bar reads "Does that": the caption repeats the title and is cut mid-phrase, and the bar is wider than its words (post-mortem 2.C).

bugs.title: The cover loses its top line in the Instagram grid, and the title sits under the account row
bugs.cause: Instagram's 3:4 grid crop cuts "USING A", and the reel's title sits under the account row; channel_safe.py checks the buttons and the caption zone, not the grid crop or the top row (post-mortem 2.D).

bugs.title: The underline is drawn on the card's border, not under its words
bugs.cause: The hand-drawn underline is placed in frame coordinates while the card sits in perspective on a tilted phone screen, so it lands on the card's bottom border; nothing checks that an annotation lands on its target (post-mortem 2.B).

bugs.title: The evidence sat on a hand-held phone, too small to read
bugs.cause: A stock hand holding a phone, with the screenshot composited onto its tilted screen: a phone inside a phone, the evidence about a third of the frame and the animation cut off at its edges. His words: "They're not full screen, specifically when there's the hand holding the phone" (post-mortem 2.A).
